decisions.reason: The existing same-message MODIFY already updates the FAQ prize explanation to one $500 winner every 100 sales and one $10,000 winner every 10,000 sales.
The existing same-message MODIFY already updates the Mission page prize-pool copy with both revised prize schedules.
Changing prize counts and draw frequency does not determine whether winners receive automatic transfers or use a manual claim flow.
The source changes prize quantities and draw intervals but does not change ticket issuance, separate counters, eligibility since the previous draw, or post-draw reset rules.
The revised prize schedules do not change ticket weighting, eligibility semantics, on-chain selection, or the Chainlink VRF randomness provider.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records one winner, a $10,000 pool target, and a draw every 10,000 sales; the unchanged $10,000 per-winner amount needs no update.
The source does not change the no-referral trigger, random-recipient rule, commission, or Small and Big Block ticket allocation.
The existing same-message MODIFY already records one winner, a $500 pool amount, and a draw every 100 sales; the unchanged $500 per-winner amount needs no update.
Changing prize frequency and winner count does not alter transfer of the book, referral code, badges, or active and expired ticket state on resale.
Message 158 changes prize schedules but does not remove or modify Aave yield generation; the later statement about redundancy cannot be propagated from this source Event.
The client explicitly preserves the net giveaway amount, and the source does not change mint price, founder allocation, referral commission, pool destinations, or residual allocation.
Both Small and Big Block ticket systems remain active, so both ticket counters, permanent badges, and the mint-number referral-code metadata remain valid unchanged.
